name: Seared Tofu & Pinto Bean Salad (Cowboy Caviar) with Cilantro Dressing
instructions: Cut tofu in half along the long side. Sandwich tofu between clean towels or paper towels and place on a baking sheet pan. Place a cutting board with something heavy on top and set aside to press out excess water.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Drain and rinse beans; set aside to drain further.
Juice limes into a medium bowl. Add oil, maple syrup, and spices; whisk to combine the dressing and set aside.
Cut tofu pieces in half crosswise, then cut each half into two triangles; place on a plate. Sprinkle with cornstarch and spices on both sides.
Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add tofu and cook, flipping once, until golden brown and warmed through, 6-8 minutes. Return to the plate.
Meanwhile, peel and mince shallots; add to the bowl with the dressing.

Quarter jalapeño pepper lengthwise; seed and remove ribs with a spoon. Mince and add to the bowl. (Be careful with jalapeños; do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.)
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl.
Trim, seed, and small dice bell pepper; add to the bowl.
Small dice tomatoes and add to the bowl.
Halve and pit avocado; scoop out with a spoon and small dice the flesh. Add to the bowl, along with the beans, and stir to combine the salad.
To serve, divide tofu and bean salad between plates. Enjoy!
author: Mealime
